# Balanced Improvement Starting Values

This table proposes balanced `startingPrice`, `startingProfit`, and `startingTime` values for places `0-10` and improvements `0-10`.

## Balancing Model
- Place scaling: `startingPrice(place p, improvement i) = basePrice[i] * 20^p`
- Starting times are fixed per improvement index
- Starting profit uses targeted payback (ROI): `startingProfit = startingPrice * startingTime / roiSeconds`
- Early improvements have faster ROI, late improvements slower ROI

## Constants
- Base prices (improvement 0..10): 4, 12, 36, 110, 330, 1000, 3000, 9000, 27000, 81000, 243000
- Starting times (seconds): 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 24, 30, 36, 44, 52, 60
- ROI targets (seconds): 45, 60, 75, 90, 120, 150, 180, 210, 240, 270, 300

## Notes
- If progression feels too fast between places, increase place multiplier from `20` to `22-25`.
- If early gameplay feels too slow, lower ROI for improvements `0-2` (for example 35-60 sec).
- If late gameplay feels too generous, increase ROI for improvements `8-10` (for example 300-420 sec).
